# ClaudeMC v1.19.2 — bugfix

## Bug fixes

### AntiSpam — operator precedence in ad-filter
The `discord.gg` server-name exception (`&& !lower.contains("server")`) never fired because
`&&` binds tighter than `||`. The condition was parsed as:

```
(shop.) || (store.) || (buy now) || (discord.gg AND NOT server)
```

but due to missing parentheses it evaluated as:

```
(shop.) || (store.) || (buy now) || discord.gg    [always blocked]
AND !server                                        [applied to whole expression]
```

Fixed by wrapping the discord.gg clause in explicit parentheses.

### AutoRespawn — NPE on getNetworkHandler() during death screen
`client.getNetworkHandler()` returns null in the window between losing connection and the
DeathScreen being displayed (e.g. during lag spikes or during reconnect). The unchecked call
caused an NPE crash. Now null-checked before `sendPacket()`.

### ElytraFlight — two NPEs on getNetworkHandler() during connection setup
Both `START_FALL_FLYING` packet sends (fall-trigger path and Packet mode tick) called
`client.getNetworkHandler()` without a null guard. The handler is transiently null during
initial connection setup. Both call sites now null-check the handler before sending.
